issues.reason: The attitude rule seals 'only for a finite clausal complement', and the set's uniform pattern for a matrix verb's non-finite eventive complement (causatives, inceptives, prevent-from) reifies it at top level under Theme, occurrence-neutral — so sealing 'to come' violates a stated restriction.

No agree-er or addressee is mentioned, so the come event's controller has no symbol — recording who was to come would mint a referent the text never states, which 'assert only what the text states' forbids; the omission is forced ellipsis plus the control-complement gap, not a defect.

gaps_confirmed: verbless expressive speech-act formula ('Thanks', 'Sorry', 'Congratulations') — no routing says whether it asserts an occurring event or what participants it takes
subject-control infinitives ('agree/promise/refuse to V') — whether and how the controller's role is copied into the complement event is unstated
gerund clause as a preposition's object — the oblique object rule covers only ordinary NPs
repair_summary: Unsealed agree's complement: (Theme sk_agree_1 sk_come_1) now points at a top-level occurrence-neutral (Member sk_come_1 come) added beside it, with no tense or status per the non-finite-complement rule; nothing else changed.
notes: The come event still carries no Agent — its controller is the unmentioned addressee, so no licensed filler exists.
